summary.text: Ram Villivalam is a Democratic member of the Illinois State Senate who has represented District 8 since January 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He was born and lives in Chicago and previously worked as a consultant with SEIU Healthcare Illinois & Indiana.

paragraphs.text: Villivalam graduated from Lincoln Park High School in 2005 and earned a bachelor's degree in political science and government from The George Washington University in 2009.
His career experience includes working as a consultant with SEIU Healthcare Illinois & Indiana.
Villivalam took office in the Illinois State Senate on January 9, 2019, succeeding Ira Silverstein.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on March 17, 2026.
